CLI · ChatGPT desktop app

the 20,122 characters of instructions Codex sends on every turn, cut by settings that are verified against your own build

install
git clone https://github.com/sup3x/codex-eco cd codex-eco && ./install.sh
Writes the rules into $CODEX_HOME/AGENTS.md. Nothing to invoke, on every model and every effort.
why not a skill
Codex publishes a skill as one catalogue line. Its body is read with a shell command — an extra round trip — and the measurement says that costs more than it saves. AGENTS.md arrives with the prompt.
197 runs published — retractions and negative results included
